evals.prompt: /to-vault --inbox, run from a non-vault repo, vault CLAUDE.md has no § Triage
evals.expected_output: Stops with a clear message that § Triage is missing and writes nothing.

evals.prompt: /to-vault "leases beat locks for job claims", run from a repo named fleet whose project MOC does not exist yet. Report the exact lines you would add to the MOCs, without writing.
evals.expected_output: Every added MOC line, including the System Design MOC line for the new fleet MOC, has the form `- [[Title]] — <when to open it>`.

evals.prompt: /to-vault https://www.notion.so/Caching-notes-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, run from a non-vault repo named fleet, `ntn` not installed. Say what you would do, without writing.
evals.expected_output: Stops, says ntn or NOTION_API_TOKEN is missing, writes nothing.

evals.prompt: /to-vault <notion-url>, run from a repo named fleet. ntn returns notes on caching and consensus. log.md already holds `Source: <notion-url>` under a Note about caching. Report the plan without writing: frontmatter project, MOCs, what is appended or created, log lines.
evals.expected_output: No `project` key; a Caching MOC and Consensus MOC created and linked from System Design MOC; the caching Note gets an appended dated section only with new material; consensus becomes a new Note; every log entry carries a `Source: <notion-url>` line.
